'''2010 US East Nationals Jon Revell LS Let The Wookiee Win (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jon Revell]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let The Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6)|VB6-L-letthewookieewin-pre.gif|label=Let The Wookiee Win (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
